channel.title: For Every Mom - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from For Every Mom (foreverymom.com)

item.title: Please Don’t Send Me Your “Positive Thoughts”
item.description: When I ask for prayer in difficult circumstances, that's what I need. Because no matter how well-intentioned, your positive thoughts don't do me any good.

item.title: What My Special Needs Child Said to Someone Who Told Her She Looks “Normal”
item.description: What my special needs daughter said to the person who told her she looked "normal" is pretty much 100% perfection.

item.title: I Thought Snapchat Was Ruining My Teen—But When She Landed in the ER, the Truth Came Out
item.description: This is an unseen side effect of snapchat, texting, selfies, and social media on our teens...and it might surprise you.

item.title: Her Daughter Got a Secret Kik Account—Just a Few Hours Later, Her Nightmare Started
item.description: My 12-year-old thought it would be fun to get a Kik account, and she did so against my rules...within 24 hours she was being blackmailed for nude photos.

item.title: A Letter to My Husband in this Weird Phase of Marriage: Let’s See it Through
item.description: This wife wrote a letter to her husband in this "weird phase" of their marriage—and received a whle lot of unsolicited advice.

item.title: This Hilarious Mom Ranting Over Her Grocery Store Remodel is ALL OF US!!
item.description: "There's MAXI PADS in the JUICE AISLE!!!!"

item.title: If Parenting Feels Hard, It Means You’re Doing It Right
item.description: Parenting is hard. You’ll never hear me say it isn’t. It’s hard because I work really hard at it. And also, nothing worthwhile is ever easy.

item.title: This Mom’s Apology to Dads Is the Truth-Bomb They ALL Need to Hear
item.description: Kristina Kuzmic's Father's Day apology to dads is soooo good, your baby daddy will want to listen to it again and again!

item.title: The Chick-Fil-A Manager Said ‘Is That YOUR Kid In the Bathroom?’—Then I Heard Screams
item.description: This mom had a SERIOUS debacle in Chick-Fil-A, and it made me laugh until I cried! Better her than me, right?

item.title: Dear Daughter: I Pray Your Future Husband Does This
item.description: My dear girl, there's something you need to know about your future husband. And it's a deal-breaker.
